items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When the Brown brothers, I think, are the ones that popularized them.

ctx.x: And would you believe me when I first come in New Orleans, I didn't know the saxophone were. I never did see a saxophone. Well, what year did they start really coming out saxophone?
I don't know. It must have been in the 20s, you know, when they really got popular. When the Brown brothers, I think, are the ones that popularized them.

Must have been in the 20s, yeah, because I left there in 17. Yeah, it was around in the 20s. That's when they started. But I know they didn't have any of them when I was playing. Clonet, bass violin, drum, guitar. Not piano. Unless you go to a place like, we should play the audibon tune on. Regular. I used to go there and play, where they had a piano. And then we'd play that man, you know, somebody comes to piano.
